uid.description: Unique identifier of the DDA account (UUID). Use to consult, update, enable or disable via API.

cnpj.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company/person for which the DDA was enabled. Each Kobana account can have only one active DDA account.

name.description: Descriptive name of the DDA letter, automatically generated based on the company's data.

signers.description: List of signatories of the DDA adoption letter (minimum 1, maximum 3). Each signatory receives an email with a link for digital signature.

name.description: Full name of the signatory as per identity document.

email.description: Signatory's email for sending the digital signature link.

role.description: Signatory's position/function in the company. Values: `partner` (partner), `witness` (witness), `legal` (legal), `attorney` (attorney), `financial` (financial), `director` (director), `representative` (representative).

editable.description: Indicates if the account allows editing of signatories. `true`: newly created or re-enabled account — it is possible to add/remove/edit signatories. `false`: letter has already been generated and sent for signature — it is not possible to edit. To edit when `false`: disable the account (PUT /disable), enable again (PUT /enable), then update the signatories (PUT /dda_accounts/:uid).

status.description: Overall approval status of the DDA account. `pending` (awaiting completion of the adoption letter — signatories have not yet signed), `awaiting_approval` (letter signed by all — awaiting approval by Kobana Manager), `approved` (account approved and active — DDA boletos synchronized automatically — `enabled_at` field filled), `signature_rejected` (letter rejected by Kobana Manager — check `rejection_reason` and `rejected_at`).

letter_status.description: Status of the adoption letter PDF generation. `not_created` (PDF not yet generated), `creating` (generation in progress), `created` (PDF successfully generated — letter sent for signature), `failed` (generation failure — check `error_message`).

external_letter_status.description: Status of the digital signature of the adoption letter with the provider. `pending` (letter generated, awaiting sending for signature), `waiting_signatures` (letter sent — awaiting signatory signatures), `signed` (all signatories signed — letter completed), `failed` (failure in the signature process with the provider).

letter_signed_url.description: URL to download the signed DDA letter. When `external_letter_status` is `signed`, this URL points to the PDF signed by all signatories. The URL is managed via ActiveStorage and remains valid. Returns `null` when the letter has not yet been signed or is not available.

error_message.description: Detailed error message when a failure occurs in the adoption letter generation. Returns `null` when there is no error.

enabled_at.description: Date and time (ISO 8601) when the DDA account was enabled/activated, **confirmed by the provider**. When `null`, the account is disabled (or an enabling was requested and still awaiting confirmation — see `enable_requested_at`).

disabled_at.description: Date and time (ISO 8601) when the DDA account was disabled, **confirmed by the provider**. After disabling, there is a grace period of 21 minutes before being able to re-enable (provider requirement).

enable_requested_at.description: Date and time (ISO 8601) when the enabling was requested (via PUT /enable), still awaiting provider confirmation. When present and `enabled_at` is still `null`, the account is in the "awaiting confirmation" state. Becomes `null` again once confirmation arrives.

disable_requested_at.description: Date and time (ISO 8601) when the disabling was requested (via PUT /disable), still awaiting provider confirmation. When present and `disabled_at` is still `null`, the account is in the "awaiting confirmation" state. Becomes `null` again once confirmation arrives.

validated_at.description: Date and time (ISO 8601) when the DDA letter was validated/approved by Kobana Manager.

rejected_at.description: Date and time (ISO 8601) when the letter was rejected by Kobana Manager. Filled when `status` is `signature_rejected`.

rejection_reason.description: Reason informed by Kobana Manager when rejecting the membership letter. Filled when `status` is `signature_rejected`.

bank_billets_sync_last_updated_at.description: Date and time (ISO 8601) of the last successful synchronization of DDA boletos. Indicates when the system fetched and processed new boletos from the provider for this account.

created_at.description: Date and time (ISO 8601) when the DDA account was created on the Kobana platform.

updated_at.description: Date and time (ISO 8601) of the last update of this DDA account.

business_legal_name.description: Legal name of the company associated with the CNPJ of the DDA account. Optional field, provided directly by the API client (without automatic CNPJ lookup).

phone_number.description: Contact phone of the company associated with the CNPJ of the DDA account. Optional field.

address.description: Address of the company associated with the CNPJ of the DDA account. All subfields are optional. Returns `{}` when no subfield was provided. An update replaces the entire hash — does not merge partially with the previous value.

zip_code.description: CEP (format 99999999 — dashes and other non-numeric characters are automatically removed).

state.description: State abbreviation. Must be a valid Brazilian state.
